tooltip.lasercraft.laser_emitter: Dye changes color; a clock toggles pulse mode.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_receiver: Outputs redstone when a beam hits its marked face.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_mirror: Redirects a beam toward its marked output.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_prism: Splits a beam into red, green, and blue.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_combiner: Mixes two or more colors arriving from different sides.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_turret: No redstone. Auto-fires at the nearest visible hostile mob; dye sets color.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_divider: Creates two copies of the incoming beam.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_amplifier: Raises beam strength up to the server limit.
tooltip.lasercraft.laser_polarizer: Only passes beams travelling in its marked direction.
tooltip.lasercraft.focusing_lens: Raises strength while halving remaining range.
tooltip.lasercraft.range_lens: Adds 32 blocks to the remaining range.
tooltip.lasercraft.color_detector: Use dye to select the color that produces redstone.
tooltip.lasercraft.color_crystal: Dye it, then any beam passing through becomes that color.
